bar-height.$description: Minimum height of the search bar, 56px at the default root size.

bar-radius.$description: Pill corner of the collapsed and docked bar.

bar-bg.$description: Fill of the collapsed and docked bar.

bar-bg-image.$description: Optional image painted over the bar fill.

bar-backdrop-filter.$description: Complete backdrop filter for the bar.

bar-fg.$description: Query ink over the search bar.

bar-placeholder.$description: Placeholder ink exposed by the Search API.

bar-placeholder-fg.$description: Default contrast pair for placeholder text over the search bar.

view-bg.$description: Raised fill of the docked and full-screen view.

view-bg-image.$description: Optional image painted over the view fill.

view-backdrop-filter.$description: Complete backdrop filter for the search view.

view-supporting-fg.$description: Ink for descriptions and the recent-search group label.

view-shadow.$description: Resting elevation of the docked view.

view-divider.$description: Divider separating the active field and full-screen results.

option-active-bg.$description: Fill of the focused or hovered suggestion.

option-active-fg.$description: Ink of the focused or hovered suggestion.

option-active-supporting-fg.$description: Description ink on the focused or hovered suggestion.

group-heading-family.$description: Font family for the recent-query group heading.

control-size.$description: Base size of actions and minimum height of search rows.

input-touch-size.$description: Minimum input font size on coarse pointers to avoid focus zoom.
